Horizontal side elevation, a broad EMPTY fairly light matte horizontal dirt road along the bottom 20 percent, perfectly level road edge across the picture at y around 820/1024, no diagonal perspective road, shading and few pebbles only. All scenery behind road; mostly open behind tank and aircraft. Cool distance, warm restrained light. Absolutely no soldiers, people, vehicles, boats, words, logos, UI, flags, poles in foreground, weapons, fires or smoke. A game panorama, no frame, no text. Lika near Gospić, early April 1945. Inland rural valley below the serrated Velebit ridge, spring thaw, pale green meadows, a few bare and budding trees, one small pale plaster farm roof and a low split-rail field boundary off to one side. Distant mountains mauve blue, a little high summit snow. Soft clear morning sky. Rural and spacious, no sea.
